title: Population, by sex and one-year age groups (M) 1986 - 2026
main_question: How did the population distribution among ages 20–54 change between 2021 and 2023, and where do women and men differ?
transformations: 2021: selected one-year ages 20–54 for women and men from SSB saved query 10054226, then summed consecutive ages into the same seven five-year groups used in 2023.
2023: selected seven five-year groups (20–24 through 50–54) for women and men using SSB built-in five-year age aggregation in saved query 10103858.
2026 overview: copied SSB selected figures for the ten published broad age groups; no further aggregation.
No interpolation, smoothing, weighting or modelled values.
comparability_note: The main comparison fixes region to the whole country, so changing municipal boundaries do not affect the comparison shown on the page.
